scope: All cases registered by the default Playwright configuration; source audit, no browser suite execution or test removal.

definitions.node: Complete asserted domain behavior can run without Chromium. Existing coverage status still governs readiness to remove it.
definitions.split: Portable semantics and real browser integration are mixed. Case count is not a removal estimate.
definitions.browser: Retain the actual browser contract; native references are supplementary, not replacements.
definitions.capture: Screenshot artifact without behavioral/image regression assertion; decide capture workflow or meaningful assertion.
definitions.covered: An existing native test covers or strengthens the portable behavior; browser boundary must be retained elsewhere if needed.
definitions.partial: Named native tests overlap; exact command, scenario, roster, persistence adapter or assertion parity remains to be established.
definitions.none: No equivalent native contract identified; this does not mean the feature has no tests.
definitions.browserCoverage: Coverage value browser means the meaningful browser boundary has no equivalent native replacement.
